storyStops.title: When water is lost, people and the environment feel the impact.
storyStops.body: Local producers who rely on Lefke’s historic aqueducts can be left with less water than they need. When losses along the channels go unnoticed, it becomes harder to respond in time and protect the historic fabric and surrounding environment.
storyStops.note: Aqua Grid aims to make possible water loss easier to spot so it can be investigated sooner.

storyStops.title: Monitor water loss while respecting the aqueducts.
storyStops.body: We want to explore discreet data-collection devices that could help identify possible water loss without harming the aqueducts’ historic fabric or disrupting their surroundings.
storyStops.note: Device design and placement would need environmental review before installation.

storyStops.title: Better questions for better decisions.
storyStops.body: Earlier visibility may help teams prioritise field inspections, make more informed water-management decisions, and build evidence for future infrastructure planning.
storyStops.note: At suitable sites, measured data could also inform a micro-hydropower feasibility study—not prove one.

storyStops.title: Measure first. Expand with evidence.
storyStops.body: A real deployment would begin with people and place: consult stakeholders, survey the channel, and select a small number of appropriate pilot sites.
storyStops.note: Sensor placement, permissions, maintenance, and operating needs all require local evaluation.

storyStops.title: Infrastructure that helps communities adapt.
storyStops.body: Aqua Grid is intended to explore how practical monitoring can support responsible water use, resilient local services, and carefully assessed clean-energy opportunities.
storyStops.note: These are areas of intended contribution, not achieved or certified outcomes.

goals: Support better observation and management of water resources.
Explore renewable energy recovery where appropriate.
Use digital monitoring to inform infrastructure decisions.
Support resilient local services and planning.
Encourage more informed use of water and infrastructure.
Explore local resilience and renewable-energy opportunities.
roadmap: Survey the channel and consult local stakeholders
Select suitable sites for a small sensor pilot
Install, calibrate, and collect real-world data
Assess hydropower feasibility at selected sites
Consider expansion with evidence and approval
